# Bill Gaize

> Product Manager and Project Manager based in Santiago, Chile (Región Metropolitana), originally from Venezuela, working across Latin America. Focused on product development, delivery and logistics operations, Shopify/e-commerce integrations, and practical AI automation.

Bill Gaize helps teams turn messy operational workflows into clear, automated systems. He combines product management, product development, software development, API integrations, AI agents, and operations experience from logistics and delivery environments in Chile and Latin America.

## What Bill does

- Product management and product development for logistics, delivery, marketplace, and operations-heavy products
- Delivery and last-mile / middle-mile logistics product management and B2B API integrations across Latin America
- AI workflow automation using agents, Telegram/email/calendar/tracker integrations, and unattended automations
- Shopify and e-commerce integrations, including API integrations, backend workflows, and operational tooling
- Full-stack web development with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and MERN-style stacks
- Internal tools, dashboards, workflow systems, and support/escalation processes
- Product strategy, process design, requirements definition, and cross-functional execution
